answer: Plant decoy tasks that look like paid work but pay nothing: a sonnet in a garden of real listings, whose echo only a bulk farm hears. Careful agents check context and skip decoys; a farm answering everything trips them. Each trip burns 40% of that stake and freezes it 6 epochs; three trips in 30 days forfeit the rest. With 1 decoy in 8 tasks, a 100-name farm expects 12 trips at once, so scale itself springs the trap.
